svg.text: THE FOUR THINGS THAT DECIDE THIS

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Mark the window from the LIT AREA, never from the PCB outline and never from a measurement. Hold the module against the fascia, power it, and scribe round what glows.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. The panel sits AT the fascia plane, not behind it. Recess a dot-matrix display and you are looking down a tunnel — contrast and viewing angle both go.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. The PCB is 100.5 mm wide against a 182 mm fascia, so it clears easily side to side. It is the 33.5 mm height against a 53 mm face that gets tight once the bezel is on.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Note which end the FFC leaves from and orient the module so it exits towards the main board, with a service loop. A ribbon pulled taut tears at the connector, not in the middle.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ Module dimensions are from the listings this project recommends; the lit area's offset within the PCB varies by supplier. Measure the one you bought.
